programme.title: (h) Erzberg. The Kreuzbergl in Klagenfurt / (h)ERZberg. Das Kreuzbergl in Klagenfurt
programme.desc: Karnten's capital has a great heart. In the middle of Klagenfurt, the Kreuzbergl extends a natural forest with a wide variety of fauna and flora. In 1957 the glacier cut of the Kreuzbergl was appointed the "natural monument". Very few know that it is essentially a historical park landscape that was created on the occasion of the visit of Emperor Franz Joseph in 1850. Today Kreuzbergl is one of the most important local recreation, leisure and sports areas for the Klagenfurter: You meet- also when visiting the botanical garden or in the observatory. Here is the births of the Lindwurm Klagenfurt, because the "Kreuzbergl shief" was most likely to hew the clamping land. The bunker plant in Kreuzbergl saved life - experiences, experiences, reports about contemporary witnesses and which the young people Ingeborg Bachmann also processed in their war diary during the 2nd World War. It is a special center of life of the Cartner Capital of the Capital, where a wide variety of living areas combine with nature, history, geology, culture, sport and astronomy in a confined space. / Karntens Landeshauptstadt hat ein grunes Herz. Mitten in Klagenfurt erstreckt sich mit dem Kreuzbergl ein naturnaher Wald mit einer breiten Vielfalt an Fauna und Flora. 1957 wurde der Gletscherschliff des Kreuzbergls zum "Naturdenkmal" ernannt. Dass es sich im Kern um eine historische Parklandschaft handelt, die anlasslich des Besuchs Kaiser Franz Josephs 1850 entstanden ist, wissen nur noch die wenigsten. Heute ist das Kreuzbergl fur die Klagenfurter eines der wichtigsten Naherholungs-, Freizeit- und Sportgebiete: Man trifft sich - auch beim Besuch des Botanischen Gartens oder in der Sternwarte. Hier liegt die Geburtsstatte des Klagenfurter Lindwurms, denn aus dem "Kreuzberglschiefer" wurde mit groSSter Wahrscheinlichkeit das Klagenfurter Wahrzeichen schlechthin gehauen. Die Bunkeranlage im Kreuzbergl rettete wahrend des 2. Weltkriegs aber auch tausenden Klagenfurtern das Leben - Erfahrungen, uber die Zeitzeugen berichten und die auch die jugendliche Ingeborg Bachmann in ihrem Kriegstagebuch verarbeitet hat. Es ist ein besonderer Lebensmittelpunkt der Karntner Landeshauptstadt, wo sich mit Natur, Geschichte, Geologie, Kultur, Sport und Astronomie unterschiedlichste Lebensbereiche auf engstem Raum vereinen.

programme.title: Mythen der Alpen
programme.desc: In extreme landscape areas such as the high alps, the powers of nature and people meet the people particularly hard: Eternal ice and snow masses make mountain spaces unsavable for months. Thunderstorms, storms and hails destroy the harvests. In the fraction of a second, avalanches, muries and lightning strikes not only destroy the livelihood of the people, but also also bring death to Bergdorfer.Enlang the myth of eternal ice, the myth of the magical places and the myth of sacred water, the film develops its earning structure. The camera sprints the place of mythical past and combines the most real stories that hide behind the legends and rites, with the grandiose high alpine nature and cultural landscape of Austria, Italy, Germany, France and Switzerland. A film by Manfred CorrineKo Orf/BMUKK / In extremen Landschaftsraumen wie den Hochalpen treffen die Gewalten der Natur und die Bedurfnisse der Menschen besonders hart aufeinander: Ewiges Eis und Schneemassen machen Gebirgspasse monatelang unbegehbar. Gewitter, Sturm und Hagel vernichten die Ernten. Lawinen, Muren und Blitzschlag zerstoren im Bruchteil einer Sekunde nicht nur die Existenzgrundlage der Menschen, sondern bringen manchmal auch den Tod in die Bergdorfer.Entlang dem Mythos vom ewigen Eis, dem Mythos von den magischen Orten und dem Mythos vom heiligen Wasser entwickelt der Film seine Erzahlstruktur. Die Kamera spurt die Platze mythischer Vergangenheit auf und verbindet die meist realen Geschichten, die sich hinter den Sagen und Riten verbergen, mit der grandiosen hochalpinen Natur- und Kulturlandschaft Österreichs, Italiens, Deutschlands, Frankreichs und der Schweiz.Ein Film von Manfred CorrineKo ORF/ARTE/BMUKK

programme.title: Wiener Walder - Grune Jouwe / Wiener Walder - Grune Juwele
programme.desc: Hardly any European capital has as much forest per inhabitant as Vienna. The Wiener Walder form the foundation of the incomparable quality of life, of which the inhabitants of many other metropolises are blacks. In the west and north of the city, the classic Wienerwald extends, in the east the Danubeau National Park is located. Anniaced forest and grunt trains can be found directly in the area installed. The core zone of the forest ownership is surprisingly hundreds of kilometers from the city. The limestone parlor around the Rax, Schneeberg and the Hochschwab-Massiv are in Viennese parish seat, at least those 32,000 hectares that are located in the catchment area of ​​the two high source water pipes. From here, the capital is supplied with drinking water. This is also Vienna: over two thousand meters high, the peaks protrude into the sky, overlook icy plateaus in winter and alpine pastures in summer. Georg Riha's cinematic foray runs through the "Forest" experience in all its incredible variety of seasons. A film by Georg Riha / Kaum eine europaische Hauptstadt besitzt pro Einwohner soviel Wald wie Wien. Die Wiener Walder bilden das Fundament jener unvergleichlichen Lebensqualitat, von der die Bewohner vieler anderer Metropolen schwarmen. Im Westen und im Norden der Stadt erstreckt sich der klassische Wienerwald, im Osten liegt der Nationalpark Donauauen. Unzahlige Waldchen und Grunzuge finden sich direkt in verbautem Gebiet. Die Kernzone des Waldbesitzes liegt jedoch erstaunlicherweise hundertfunfzig Kilometer von der Stadt entfernt. Die Kalkalpen rund um die Rax, den Schneeberg und das Hochschwab-Massiv stehen in Wiener Gemeindebesitz, zumindest jene 32.000 Hektar, die im Einzugsgebiet der beiden beruhmten Hochquellwasserleitungen liegen. Von hier aus wird die Hauptstadt mit Trinkwasser versorgt. Auch das ist Wien: Über zweitausend Meter hoch ragen die Gipfel in den Himmel, uberschauen im Winter eisige Plateaus und im Sommer bluhende Almen. Georg Rihas filmischer Streifzug fuhrt durch das Erlebnis "Wald" in all seiner unglaublichen Vielfalt im Wandel der Jahreszeiten.Ein Film von Georg Riha

programme.title: Mythos Baum
programme.desc: The film travels into the exciting world of old tree giants, which has been rooted in Styria, the most forested state of Austria, for many centuries. 600 tree is shown in this country as a natural monument - the film shows us some of this natural scathetic and leads us from the "oldest oak in Europe" to the "Konigin of the Alps", the Swiss Center, from resistance -long ginkgo to the gigantic mammoth tree, from the healing strength of the linden to the healthy effect of the larch. The tree is illuminated as a living being, with its seams, its use, its inhabitants and its cultural importance. In addition to all these exciting aspects, small anecdotes characterize the tree giants. Who and what these methusalems have already seen in their tree life? Director Alfred Ninaus accompanied this old tree in film for a year and portrayed her life in the change of seasons. / Der Film reist in die spannende Welt alter Baumriesen, die in der Steiermark, dem waldreichsten Bundesland Österreichs, seit vielen Jahrhunderten ihre Wurzeln schlagen. 600 Baume sind hierzulande als Naturdenkmaler ausgewiesen - der Film zeigt uns einige dieser Naturschatze und fuhrt uns von der "altesten Eiche Europas" bis zur "Konigin der Alpen", der Zirbe, vom widerstandsfahigen Ginkgo bis zum gigantischen Mammutbaum, von den heilenden Kraften der Linde bis zur gesunden Wirkung der Larche. Beleuchtet wird der Baum als Lebewesen, mit seinen Fahigkeiten, seiner Nutzung, seinen Bewohnern und seiner kulturellen Bedeutung. Neben all diesen spannenden Aspekten charakterisieren kleine Anekdoten die Baumriesen. Wen und was diese Methusalems wohl schon in ihrem Baumleben gesehen haben? Regisseur Alfred Ninaus hat diese alten Baume ein Jahr lang filmisch begleitet und ihr Leben im Wechsel der Jahreszeiten portratiert.

programme.title: ORF III AKTUELL am Nachmittag
programme.desc: Also in 2025 "ORF III currently in the afternoon" on Mondays and Wednesdays at 4:00 p.m. With in -depth analyzes, exciting discussions and well -founded reporting, the program accompanies political developments in and around Austria. A wide range of background reports, opinions of experts or live interviews provide a comprehensive overview of the relevant events at home and abroad. / Auch 2025 verstarkt "ORF III AKTUELL am Nachmittag" jeweils montags und mittwochs um 16.00 Uhr die bereits etablierte Infoleiste von ORF III. Mit vertiefenden Analysen, spannenden Diskussionen und fundierter Berichterstattung begleitet die Sendung die politischen Entwicklungen in and um Österreich. Eine breite Palette an Hintergrundberichten, Meinungen von Expertinnen und Experten bzw. Live-Interviews geben einen umfassenden Überblick uber die relevanten Geschehnisse im In- und Ausland.

programme.title: Traumorte
programme.desc: As the largest Canadian province, Quebec is a unique area in North America. The French -speaking enclave on an anglosxic continent has managed to maintain its cultural identity and at the same time open up with a city like Montreal in the world. Quebec is a region full of natural miracles, a place where friendliness and human warm are in a strong contrast to its vastness and lonely ice area. For everyone who has visited Quebec, his motto is true: "I remember." / Als groSSte kanadische Provinz ist Quebec eine einzigartige Gegend in Nordamerika. Die franzosischsprechende Enklave auf einem anglosachsischen Kontinent hat es geschafft seine kulturelle Identitat zu erhalten und sich gleichzeitig mit einer Stadt wie Montreal auch der Welt zu offnen. Quebec ist eine Region voller Naturwunder, ein Ort wo Freundlichkeit und menschliche Warme im starken Kontrast zu seiner Weite und einsamen Eisgegenden stehen.Fur jeden, der Quebec besucht hat, bewahrheitet sich sein Motto: "I remember."

programme.title: Traumorte
programme.desc: Rajasthan, known as the "Land of the Konige", is the largest state of the Indian Union. The life of its 68 million inhabitants is still determined by old traditions. Holi, the everyday festival of colors, is the most based and acts like a prism through which we discover this legendary land of the MaharaSchas. A journey into the timeless India, which offers a full of impressions and unforgettable experiences thanks to the splendor and the picturesque charm of its palace, its art and its people. / Rajasthan, bekannt als das "Land der Konige" ist der groSSte Bundesstaat der Indischen Union.Das Leben seiner 68 Millionen Einwohner wird noch immer von alten Traditionen bestimmt. Holi, das alljahrliche Fest der Farben, ist das beruhmteste und wirkt wie ein Prisma, durch das wir dieses legendare Land der Maharadschas entdecken.Eine Reise in das zeitlose Indien, das dank der Pracht und des malerischen Charmes seiner Palaste, seiner Kunste und seiner Menschen eine Fulle von Eindrucken und unvergesslichen Erfahrungen bietet.

programme.title: MERYN am Montag
programme.sub-title: Vitamins - boosters for autumn? / Vitamine - Booster fur den Herbst?
programme.desc: The classic cold season begins in Austria. Many ask themselves: can you prevent vitamins? The fact is: a balanced food with a lot of fresh fruit and gems starles our immune system. Apples, pears, grapes or cranes provide plenty of vitamins and antioxidants that subside the body. Vitamin D is also important - since the sun seems weaker, the body's own production sinks, but which vitamins are really crucial for our health? Is a balanced food enough? Or are we dependent on food supplements? And how can everyone in everyday life worry about strongly strong? Siegfried Meryn answers her questions together with Pia Plaszotti, specialist for internal medicine and endocrinology, in Meryn on Monday. Send us your questions or experience by email to medical@orf.at or via WhatsApp at +43/1/87878-25614. / Mit dem Herbst beginnt in Österreich die klassische Erkaltungssaison. Viele fragen sich: Kann man mit Vitaminen vorbeugen? Tatsache ist: Eine ausgewogene Ernahrung mit viel frischem Obst und Gemuse starkt unser Immunsystem. Äpfel, Birnen, Trauben oder Kurbis liefern reichlich Vitamine und Antioxidantien, die den Korper unterstutzen. Wichtig ist auch Vitamin D - da die Sonne schwacher scheint, sinkt die korpereigene Produktion.Aber welche Vitamine sind wirklich entscheidend fur unsere Gesundheit? Reicht eine ausgewogene Ernahrung aus? Oder sind wir auf Nahrungserganzungsmittel angewiesen? Und wie kann jede und jeder im Alltag dafur sorgen, das Immunsystem zu starken? Siegfried Meryn beantwortet Ihre Fragen zusammen mit Pia Plasenzotti, Facharztin fur Innere Medizin und Endokrinologie, in MERYN am Montag. Schicken Sie uns Ihre Fragen oder Erfahrungen per Mail an medizin@orf.at oder via WhatsApp unter +43/1/87878-25614.

programme.title: Kultur Heute
programme.desc: Jan Philipp Gloger, director and artistic director of the Vienna Theater Vienna has been a guest. On the game's schedule, the premieres of Jura Soyfer's end of the world and Astoria as well as the production I might hike to the Milky Way. In addition, according to Michael Haneke's film, Cache is shown in the direction of Felicitas Brucker. This day Heinz Sichrovsky's "Foyer" reviews are sent from the folk theater. The new director exposes both reviews in the studio. In the conversation, he paid for his project and attitude as the head of the folk theater. / Zu Gast ist Jan Philipp Gloger, Regisseur und seit 2025 Kunstlerischer Direktor des Volkstheaters Wien. Auf dem Spielplan des Hauses stehen derzeit die premieren von Jura Soyfers Weltuntergang und Astoria sowie die Produktion Ich mochte zur MilchstraSSe wandern. Zudem wird Cache nach dem Film von Michael Haneke in der Regie von Felicitas Brucker gezeigt.An diesem Tag werden Heinz Sichrovskys "Foyer"-Kritiken aus dem Volkstheater gesendet. Der neue Direktor setzt sich im Studio beiden Kritiken aus. Im Gesprach erzahlt er uber seine Vorhaben und seine Haltung als Chef des Volkstheaters.

programme.title: Blown and wasted - the Schmah with the full fabrics / Aufgeblasen und verwassert - der Schmah mit den Fullstoffen
programme.desc: We often pay in the supermarkets for things that actually don't cost anything, namely for air and water. Ice, for example, consists of air up to half. It makes it creamier, but also more expensive than we think, because in the end we pay the double price for half the content. So rather an air number when it comes to consumer protection. The meat industry is also letters washed with all water. Because there the product weight is increased with added water - often beyond the permitted extent. In this new production, the microbiologist Fritz drivers inaugurated the company secrets of the food industry and shows in which shelves are the greatest mogue packs. / Oft zahlen wir in den Supermarkten fur Dinge, die eigentlich nichts kosten, namlich fur Luft und Wasser. Eis etwa besteht bis zur Halfte aus Luft. Die macht es zwar cremiger, aber auch teurer als wir denken, denn am Ende zahlen wir den doppelten Preis fur den halben Inhalt. Also eher eine Luftnummer, wenn es nach Konsumentenschutzern geht. Auch die Fleischindustrie ist buchstablich mit allen Wassern gewaschen. Denn dort wird das Produktgewicht mit zugesetztem Wasser erhoht - oft uber das erlaubte MaSS hinaus. In dieser Neuproduktion weiht der Mikrobiologe Fritz Treiber in die Betriebsgeheimnisse der Lebensmittelindustrie ein und zeigt, in welchen Regalen die groSSten Mogelpackungen stecken.

programme.title: Nelson Muller - The fat compass / Nelson Muller - der Fett-Kompass
programme.desc: It depends on your quality. Nelson Muller shows how everyone finds good products very easily. Because burgers, margarine or chips have to be bad. Fats are not only in vegetable oils, but also in animal products such as meat and kase. They have a bad reputation because they contain a lot of sad fat saws. In an experiment with three young people, it shows which fats are really healthy for us and which are not. Chips belong to the most fatty foods. It is usually difficult not to eat the whole pack. But how much fat is still okay, and how much is too much? Nelson Muller travels to the Allgau to a chips manufacturer to find out exactly that. In any case, it is certain: Without fat, some products simply make no sense. / Auf ihre Qualitat kommt es an. Nelson Muller zeigt, wie jeder ganz leicht gute Produkte findet. Denn Burger, Margarine oder Chips mussen nicht schlecht sein. Fette stecken nicht nur in pflanzlichen Ölen, sondern auch in tierischen Produkten wie Fleisch und Kase. Die haben einen schlechten Ruf, weil sie viele gesattigte Fettsauren enthalten. In einem Experiment mit drei jungen Menschen zeigt sich, welche Fette wirklich gesund fur uns sind und welche nicht. Chips gehoren zu den fetthaltigsten Lebensmitteln. Da fallt es meist schwer, nicht die ganze Packung zu essen. Aber wie viel Fett ist eigentlich noch okay, und wie viel ist zu viel? Nelson Muller reist ins Allgau zu einem Chips-Hersteller, um genau das herauszufinden. Sicher ist jedenfalls: Ohne Fett machen manche Produkte einfach keinen Sinn.

programme.title: Die Fett-Hysterie
programme.desc: Hardly any food component is currently demonized as fat: If you follow the landlau -running opinion, fat is the evil of par excellence that is from a healthy way of life. Low -fat products are therefore booming. But what is it really about with the fat, without which our body does not work out? For the ORF, medical journalist Bernhard Hain examines the various properties of fat in this new production and clears up with numerous gait ideas. Some products that we consume for their high health value are actually no better than those that we have banished from the same Grunden from our dining table. The functions of an energy storage and an inner warmth collection are also not to be taken in the fat in our body. / Kaum ein Nahrungsbaustein wird derzeit so verteufelt wie Fett: Folgt man der landlaufigen Meinung, ist Fett der Übeltater schlechthin, der uns von einer gesunden Lebensweise abhalt. Fettarme Produkte haben daher Hochkonjunktur. Doch was hat es wirklich auf sich mit dem Fett, ohne das ja unser Korper nicht auskommt? Fur den ORF untersucht Medizinjournalist Bernhard Hain in dieser Neuproduktion die verschiedenen Eigenschaften des Fettes und raumt dabei mit zahlreichen gangigen Vorstellungen auf. So sind manche Produkte, die wir fur ihren hohen gesundheitlichen Wert konsumieren, in Wahrheit nicht besser als jene, die wir aus denselben Grunden von unserem Esstisch verbannt haben. Auch die Funktionen eines Energiespeichers und einer inneren Warmedammung sind dem Fett in unserem Korper nicht zu nehmen.

programme.title: treffpunkt medizin
programme.desc: Most of the mussels are talented and cared for, but according to scientific knowledge, too many pats are not doing so well for the gem. On the contrary: Gemuse needs stress. Because, in addition to vitamins and minerals, plants also form so -called secondary plant substances. They not only give the fruit and gems the bright colors and the fragrance, they also form a defense system, for example, against predators, heat and cold, insects, fungal attack or chemistry. And these fabrics also work in different ways in the human body. This "Meeting point Medicine" new production is a colorful walk through the Gemusegarten and its secondary plant substances. What do you actually know about these plant substances? What is research and what is the true superfood? Or can the colorful, diverse tubers, seeds, fruits and leaves perhaps deliver everything that stops healthy? Every fruit in your own way? / Zumeist werden Gemusegarten gehatschelt und gepflegt, doch geht es nach wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen, tun zu viele Streicheleinheiten dem Gemuse nicht so gut. Im Gegenteil: Gemuse braucht Stress. Denn, neben Vitaminen und Mineralstoffen, bilden Pflanzen auch so genannte Sekundare Pflanzenstoffe. Sie geben dem Obst und Gemuse nicht nur die leuchtenden Farben und den Duft, sie bilden auch ein Abwehrsystem zum Beispiel gegen Fressfeinde, Hitze und Kalte, Insekten, Pilzbefall oder Chemie. Und diese Stoffe wirken auf unterschiedliche Art und Weise auch im menschlichen Korper.Diese "treffpunkt medizin"-Neuproduktion ist ein bunter Spaziergang durch den Gemusegarten und seine Sekundaren Pflanzenstoffe. Was weiSS man tatsachlich uber diese Pflanzenstoffe? Woran wird geforscht und was ist das wahre Superfood? Oder konnen die kunterbunten, vielgestaltigen Knollen, Samen, Fruchte und Blatter vielleicht tatsachlich alles liefern, was gesund halt? Jede Frucht auf ihre Art?

programme.title: treffpunkt medizin
programme.desc: You can already see it in terms such as flexitarians, vegans or paleo eaters, the type of food is now a question of faith - all the more important to have stubborn myths on hard facts: what is it about the saying "You are what you eat"? Is protein always better than carbohydrates and fats? And make light products really slim? / Man sieht es schon an Begriffen wie Flexitarier, VeganerInnen oder Paleo-Esser, die Art der Ernahrung ist mittlerweile eine Glaubensfrage - umso wichtiger, hartnackige Mythen auf harte Fakten treffen zu lassen: Was ist dran an dem Spruch "Du bist, was du isst"? Ist EiweiSS immer besser als Kohlenhydrate und Fette? Und machen Lightprodukte wirklich schlank?

programme.title: Erlebnis Buhne
programme.sub-title: The classic podcast episode 27 / Der Klassikpodcast Folge 27
programme.desc: In September, the Haydnsaal in Esterházy Castle in Eisenstadt will turn into a place of large musical encounters: At the autumn gold festival this year, the violinist Janine Jansen and festival director Julian Rachlin meet. Multi-talent Julian Rachlin takes on the concert evening, which is broadcast in ORF III, the musical direction of the renowned Chamber Orchestra of Europe.Tes is offered a varied program: Mozart's "Haffner Symphony", Mendelssohn's violin concert in Emoll and Beethoven's "Eroica". Dedication.haydnsaal, Esterházy Castle 2025 / Im September verwandelt sich der Haydnsaal im Schloss Esterházy in Eisenstadt wieder in einen Ort groSSer musikalischer Begegnungen: Beim diesjahrigen Herbstgold - Festival treffen die Geigerin Janine Jansen und Festivalintendant Julian Rachlin aufeinander. Multitalent Julian Rachlin ubernimmt an dem Konzertabend, welcher in ORF III ausgestrahlt wird, wieder die musikalische Leitung des renommierten Chamber Orchestra of Europe.Es wird ein vielseitiges Programm geboten: Mozarts "Haffner-Sinfonie", Mendelssohns Violinkonzert in e-Moll sowie Beethovens "Eroica".Ein Abend voller Ausdruck, Energie und kunstlerischer Hingabe.Haydnsaal, Schloss Esterházy 2025

programme.title: Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.title: Under Dinos - Secrets of prehistoric times / Unter Dinos - Geheimnisse der Urzeit
programme.desc: 71 million years ago, the young Albertosaur female Rose, as a member of a pack, not only has to assert itself against dangers, but also find their place in the group. Albertosaurs are relatives of T. Rex. Unlike the furrowed single gangs, however, they were able to live and hunted as a group. At least this is what palaontologist Mark Powers and his team from the fossils, which they dig out at the Red Deer River in Canada. Rex. Anders als der gefurchtete Einzelganger konnten sie jedoch als Gruppe gelebt und gejagt haben. Das zumindest schlieSSen Palaontologe Mark Powers und sein Team aus den Fossilien, die sie am Red Deer River in Kanada ausgraben.Die Forschenden versuchen zu rekonstruieren, wie sich die junge Rose in einem Albertosaurus-Rudel durchgesetzt haben konnte und welchen Herausforderungen sie sich stellen musste. Denn das Leben im Rudel stellt viele Anforderungen an jedes Mitglied. Wie wird beispielweise der Frieden in der Gruppe bewahrt? Welche Jagdstrategie verspricht Erfolg, wenn schnelle Laufer und bissstarke Riesen zusammenarbeiten? Rose Schicksal fuhrt uns zu einer spannenden Entdeckung der Geheimnisse eines der erfolgreichsten Raubtiere der Kreidezeit.

programme.title: Titanic Expedition into the heart of the wreck / Titanic - Expedition ins Herz des Wracks
programme.desc: The downfall of the "Titanic" is the most limited of all ship disaster and became a myth. The ocean giant has been in the ice -cold depths of the North Atlantic for more than 100 years. First of all, the wreck was discovered in 1985 and has been visited by several elaborate diving expeditions since then. The last took place in 2019 and delivered spectacular pictures. Maybe the last. Because bacteria that disintegrate metal accelerate the decay of the "Titanic". The "Titanic" was the greatest ship of its time and was considered unsinkable. The world was all the more shocked when the ocean leader decreased on his maiden voyage in April 1912 and around 1,500 people tore down. The wreck is about 3800 meters deep in full darkness and was unreachable for a long time. After many failed attempts, a team of American and French scientists finally discovered the wreck in 1985. Later, director James Cameron filmed the downfall in one of the greatest Hollywood blockbusters of all time and also included the wreck in the filming. Since then, research teams have been able to penetrate into the hostile depth, to measure the wreck and document its condition. The expeditions were the most exciting projects in their lives, of which they report in exclusive interviews. The research opportunities have continuously better over the decades. More powerful submarines, 3-D scans and microbiological examinations today provide information about the course of the doom and the condition of the wreck. Again and again it was possible to recover objects. More than 5000 objects have now been saved and preserved. The foundations and video recordings that the researchers brought to the water surface gave an emotional insight into the action from 1912. The research is a race against time, because the wreck, which is now under protection as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is increasingly decaying. It is not only rusting, it is decomposed by a huge colony metal of loving bacteria. How much time does the researchers have to air the council of the world's most resourceful shipwreck? A story that interweaves technical possibilities, new marine biological knowledge and the adventure spirit of the research teams involved into an exciting dramaturgy. / Der Untergang der "Titanic" ist die beruhmteste aller Schiffskatastrophen und wurde zum Mythos. Seit mehr als 100 Jahren liegt der Ozeanriese in den eiskalten Tiefen des Nordatlantiks.Erst 1985 wurde das Wrack entdeckt und seitdem von mehreren aufwendigen Tauchexpeditionen besucht. Die letzte fand 2019 statt und lieferte spektakulare Bilder. Vielleicht die letzten. Denn Bakterien, die Metall zersetzen, beschleunigen den Verfall der "Titanic".Die "Titanic" war das groSSte Schiff seiner Zeit und galt als unsinkbar. Umso schockierter war die Welt, als der Ozeanriese bei seiner Jungfernfahrt im April 1912 sank und rund 1500 Menschen in den Tod riss. Das Wrack liegt etwa 3800 Meter tief in volliger Finsternis und war lange Zeit unerreichbar.Nach vielen gescheiterten Versuchen entdeckte schlieSSlich ein Team aus amerikanischen und franzosischen Wissenschaftlern 1985 das Wrack. Spater verfilmte der Regisseur James Cameron den Untergang in einem der groSSten Hollywoodblockbuster aller Zeiten und bezog auch das Wrack mit in die Dreharbeiten ein. Seither gelang es Forschungsteams mehrfach, in die lebensfeindliche Tiefe vorzudringen, das Wrack zu vermessen und seinen Zustand zu dokumentieren.Fur die jeweiligen Expeditionsleiter, darunter auch James Cameron, waren die Expeditionen die aufregendsten Projekte ihres Lebens, von denen sie in exklusiven Interviews berichten. Die Forschungsmoglichkeiten wurden uber die Jahrzehnte kontinuierlich besser. Leistungsstarkere U-Boote, 3-D-Scans und mikrobiologische Untersuchungen geben heute Aufschluss uber den Ablauf des Untergangs und den Zustand des Wracks. Immer wieder gelang es auch, Gegenstande zu bergen. Mehr als 5000 Objekte sind mittlerweile gerettet und konserviert. Die Fundstucke und Videoaufnahmen, die die Forscher mit an die Wasseroberflache brachten, geben einen emotionalen Einblick in das Geschehen von 1912.Die Forschungen sind ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit, denn das Wrack, das heute als UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe unter Schutz steht, zerfallt immer mehr. Es rostet nicht nur, es wird zersetzt von einer riesigen Kolonie Metall liebender Bakterien. Wie viel Zeit bleibt den Forschern, um die Ratsel des beruhmtesten Schiffswracks der Welt zu luften? Eine Geschichte, die technische Moglichkeiten, neue meeresbiologische Erkenntnisse sowie den Abenteuergeist der beteiligten Forschungsteams zu einer spannenden Dramaturgie verwebt.

programme.desc: The headquarters were the control centers of the Nazi dictatorship. Hitler planned his campaign there. Doch schon bei Kriegsausbruch befahl der selbst ernannte Feldherr den Bau fester Fuhrerhauptquartiere im Westen - als Vorbereitung fur den geplanten Krieg gegen Frankreich.Bei Bad Nauheim entstand der Adlerhorst, das Felsennest bei Bad Munstereifel. Es ist die erste Begegnung der beiden.Mit Verzogerung beginnt das delikate, vor der Öffentlichkeit klein gehaltene Treffen, das die Erbfeindschaft zwischen Frankreich und Deutschland beenden soll. Schnell aber werden politische Differenzen deutlich. Die Annaherung droht zu scheitern.De Gaulles Frau Yvonne versucht den Druck, der auf der Begegnung lastet, bei jeder Gelegenheit zu lockern. Denn auch die Berater der beiden Staatsmanner, Gunther Bachmann und Gaston De Bonneval, tragen ihre fundamentalen Meinungsverschiedenheiten hinter den Kulissen mit offenem Visier aus.Vor den Toren von de Gaulles Privathaus in Colombey-les-Deux-Églises wartet eine kleine Schar Journalisten ungeduldig auf Ergebnisse. Dabei lernen sich die franzosische Fotografin Helène Wissembach und die deutsche Journalistik-Volontarin Elke Schmitz kennen. Beide traumen von einer friedlichen Zukunft in einem gemeinsamen Europa und fordern von den Politikern, sich dafur einzusetzen."An einem Tag im September" ist bereits ab Samstag, 6. September 2025 in Web und App des ZDF verfugbar.

programme.title: One day in September. The documentation / An einem Tag im September. Die Dokumentation
programme.desc: The documentary for the television film "On a day in September" reflects the first meeting in 1958 by Chancellor Adenauer with France's head of government De Gaulle at his private seat. It is a symbolic turn of the turn of Franco-German history. For centuries, the "hereditary enemy" had been in the relationship between the two countries. The statesmen had experienced the abyss of both world wars. How could you override this gap? For centuries, the wars between the neighbors leave deep traces. September 14, 1958 is considered a symbolic turning point: On this day, the German Chancellor Konrad Adenauer and the French Prime Minister Charles de Gaulle met for the first time in Colombey-les-deutix-Églises, where de Gaulle had his private country seat, the symbolism of which pointed to the future. In the following years there were 14 other encounters, partly spectacular, acclaimed joint appearances such as in Bonn or Reims. With their signature under the Elysee Treaty on January 22, 1963 and a warm hug, the statesmen fell the departure into a new era of intergovernmental relationships. Today the German-French tandem is considered a trend-setting engine for Europe, also in the face of new threats. Interview with the granddaughter of Konrad Adenauer, Bettina Adenauer, with Anne de Laroullière, granddaughter of Charles de Gaulle, with Adenauer's biographer Frank Bosch, director of the Leibniz Center for Commercial History Research in Potsdam and the biographer Gaulles Frederique Neau-Dufour and with Helène Miiard-Delacroix, professor at the Sorbonne in Paris add the documentation. / Die Doku zum Fernsehfilm "An einem Tag im September" reflektiert das erste Treffen 1958 von Bundeskanzler Adenauer mit Frankreichs Regierungschef de Gaulle auf dessen Privatsitz .Es ist ein symboltrachtiger Wendepunkt der deutsch-franzosischen Geschichte. Über Jahrhunderte galt im Verhaltnis der beiden Staaten die "Erbfeindschaft". Die Staatsmanner hatten die Abgrunde beider Weltkriege erlebt. Wie konnten sie diese Kluft uberbrucken?Über Jahrhunderte hinterlieSSen die Kriege zwischen den Nachbarn tiefe Spuren. Der 14. September 1958 gilt da als symbolischer Wendepunkt: An diesem Tag begegneten sich der deutsche Bundeskanzler Konrad Adenauer und der franzosische Regierungschef Charles de Gaulle zum ersten Mal in Colombey-les-Deux-Églises, wo de Gaulle seinen privaten Landsitz hatte.Es wurde ein herzliches Treffen, dessen Symbolik ganz in die Zukunft wies. In den folgenden Jahren gab es 14 weitere Begegnungen, teils spektakulare, umjubelte gemeinsame Auftritte wie in Bonn oder Reims. Mit ihrer Unterschrift unter den Elysee-Vertrag am 22. Januar 1963 und einer herzlichen Umarmung bekraftigten die Staatsmanner den Aufbruch in eine neue Ära zwischenstaatlicher Beziehungen. Heute gilt das deutsch-franzosische Tandem als richtungsweisender Motor fur Europa, auch angesichts neuer Bedrohungen.Interviews mit der Enkelin von Konrad Adenauer, Bettina Adenauer, mit Anne de Laroullière, Enkelin von Charles de Gaulle, mit Adenauers Biograf Frank Bosch, Direktor des Leibniz-Zentrums fur Zeithistorische Forschung in Potsdam und der Biografin de Gaulles Frederique Neau-Dufour sowie mit Helène Miard-Delacroix, Professorin an der Sorbonne in Paris erganzen die Dokumentation.

programme.title: Sports Classics: Temples of Sport
programme.desc: Alpe d Huez. The Temples of Sport is a series of documentaries that reveals the stories behind some of the most legendary stadiums on the planet. By interviewing persons closely linked to the stadium, each episode reveals the elements that make the spaces so magical. / Alpe d Huez. programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. programme.desc: Under the interference of the European Handball Organization since 1961. The Champions League is held for the best female teams of the Old Continent. programme.desc: The World Athletic Championship is a competition under IAAF ingeneration. The first edition was held in 1983. in the Finland Helsinki capital. programme.title: Brighton and Hove Albion vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City ; last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad. Manchester City have won 19 out of 30 league matches against Brighton – among the 46 teams they’ve faced 25+ times, the only side they have a higher win ratio against is Swansea City.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Fulham - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Chelsea have lost just 8.3% of their Premier League games against Fulham, the joint-lowest loss rate one side has against another with a minimum of 20 meetings. Fulham won this exact fixture 2-1 last season, ending a 21-game winless streak away to Chelsea in all competitions. They’ve never won consecutive visits to Stamford Bridge in their history.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Liverpool are winless in six Premier League matches against Arsenal, their longest winless run against the Gunners since going eight without a win between October 2007 and April 2011. The last three Premier League games between Liverpool and Arsenal at Anfield have all been drawn, while the Gunners are winless in their last 12 away games against the Reds since a 2-0 win back in September 2012, with manager Mikel Arteta starting for the Gunners that day.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Burnley - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just one of their last 25 home games against Burnley in all competitions, going down 2-0 in January 2020. Of all teams to have visited Manchester United at least eight times in the Premier League, Burnley are one of three teams to have avoided defeat in more than half, along with Chelsea and Manchester City.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Nottingham Forest - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4
programme.desc: In all competitions, Arsenal have won their last six home games against Nottingham Forest by an aggregate score of 19-2. The Gunners are unbeaten in 14 games on home soil against Forest since a 3-1 defeat back in March 1989. Nottingham Forest have won just two out of 16 Premier League matches against Arsenal and both wins came at the City Ground, in 1996-97 and 2022-23.

programme.title: Real Sociedad vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4
programme.desc: Real Sociedad have lost their last four LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in the last three. The San Sebastián side have never lost four consecutive matches without scoring against Los Blancos in the history of the competition. Real Madrid have won 12 of the 21 matches they have played at Anoeta against Real Sociedad in LaLiga in the 21st Century, becoming the away team with the most wins at the San Sebastian sides ground in the competition since then.

programme.title: PANENKA, GAME CHANGER
programme.desc: The remarkable story of how one man revolutionized football in 1976 by inventing a new way to take penalties—and unveiling it on the sport’s grandest and most dramatic stage.

programme.title: Canada vs USA - 3rd Place - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: Bronze is on the line after a quick turnaround. The USA are record AmeriCup winners with seven titles, while Canada are chasing a statement podium. The senior series favors the USA 21–2, although the most recent major clash flipped the script: Canada beat the USA 127–118 after overtime for 2023 World Cup bronze in Manila. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 bronze game, which the USA won 84–80. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: USA No. 1, Canada No. 6. Bench depth, defensive rebounding, and three-point efficiency are likely to separate them.

programme.title: Argentina vs Brazil - Final - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: South America’s classic rivalry decides the AmeriCup. Argentina are the reigning champions with three titles (2001, 2011, 2022), while Brazil are four-time winners (1984, 1988, 2005, 2009). Argentina lead the senior head-to-head 25–17. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 final in Recife, which Argentina won 75–73; at the 2019 World Cup second round, Argentina won 87–73. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: Argentina No. 8, Brazil No. 12. Expect a tactical game where turnover margin, second-chance points, and late free throws decide it.

programme.title: Qualifying - Catalonia GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: Timing and tow are crucial. Riders chase clear air yet seek a draft for the long straight. Clean sectors through fast, flowing corners set pole chances. Confidence and precision separate the front row from the pack.

programme.title: Sprint Race - Catalonia GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: Lightweight prototypes and fearless young riders produce pack racing at Barcelona-Catalunya. Slipstreams down the main straight, late braking and side-by-side cornering create constant lead changes. Race craft, tire feel and composure decide the podium.

programme.title: Main Race - Catalonia GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: Classic Moto3 drama: big groups, relentless overtakes and a sprint to the line. Slipstream runs decide moves into Turn 1 and the final chicane. Patience early, aggression late often wins in Barcelona.

Sarezza Stumble Guys
programme.desc: The well-known author of the game about games, Sara Miljković, in the world of games known as Sarezza, is represented by Stumble Guys. In this game 32 players on the network race, jump and chase to the goal, until the best win the crown. / Poznata autorka videozapisa o igrama, Sara Miljković, u svetu igara poznata kao Sarezza, predstavlja nam Stumble Guys. U ovoj igri 32 igrača na mreži trkaju se, skaču i jure do cilja, sve dok najbolji ne osvoji krunu.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League
programme.desc: We take you to the world of hybrid football in which a player is operating a car that strives to control the ball greater than yourself. The goal of the game is, as in football, score. / Vodimo vas u svet hibridnog fudbala u kome igrač upravlja automobilom koji nastoji da kontroliše loptu veću od sebe. Cilj igre je, kao i u fudbalu, postići gol.

programme.title: Cold Heart and Snake - Tekken 8
programme.desc: Presentation of the Tekken 8 game directed by Cold Heart and Snake. The game is, like most martial arts, based on one -on -one fight. / Predstavljanje igre Tekken 8 u režiji Cold Heart-a i Snake-a. Igra je, kao i većina borilačkih igara, bazirana na borbi jedan na jedan.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tkdspale - Fortnite Racing
programme.desc: Follow the clip of the adrenaline race and enjoy the speed of the best cars! / Pratite isečak adrenalinske trke i uživajte u brzini najboljih automobila!

programme.title: Sarezza Minecraft: Season 2 / Sarezza Minecraft: Sezona 2
programme.desc: The show is intended for all the MINECRAFT GAMES. Discover numerous secrets and tricks to help you improve your skills in playing this game! / Emisija namenjena svim ljubiteljima igrice Minecraft. Otkrijte brojne tajne i trikove koji će vam pomoći da unapredite svoje veštine u igranju ove igrice!

programme.title: Lineup with his own / Lineup Sa Svojićem
programme.desc: The famous Gamer Vukan Vrojić takes us to the world of e-sports - Meet the game Lineup. / Poznati gejmer Vukan Svojić vodi nas u svet e-sporta - upoznajte igru Lineup.

programme.title: Kada Migzi Postane Senka - Assassins Creed Shadows
programme.desc: We bring you a review of the game that has been published in March 2025. year and is part of the popular Franchise Assassins Creed. Return to Japan during the 16th century and participate in the fighting two opposing military formations. / Donosimo vam recenziju igrice koja je objavljena u martu 2025. godine i deo je popularne franšize Assassins Creed. Vratite se u Japan tokom 16. veka i učestvujte u borbama dve suprotstavljene vojne formacije.

programme.title: EWC 25 - PUBG: and 2 / EWC 25 - PUBG: Dan 2
programme.desc: This year, some of the best players of the world will gather in order to measure forces on the World Cup in E-Sports. Follow the tender in the game where the main goal is to beat all the enemies and remain the only survivors ... / I ove godine, neki od najboljih igrača sveta okupiće se kako bi odmerili snage na Svetskom kupu u e-sportu. Pratite nadmetanje u igrici u kojoj je glavni cilj pobediti sve neprijatelje i ostati jedini preživeli...

programme.title: Migzi od Persia - Prince of Persia The Lost Crown / Migzi Od Persije - Prince Of Persia the Lost Crown
programme.desc: We bring a review of the game that is part of the popular franchise of the Prince of Persia. The main hero is Sargon who has to face a number of challenges while trying to make a mission. / Donosimo recenziju igrice koja je deo popularne franšize Princ od Persije. Glavni junak je Sargon koji mora da se suoči sa brojnim izazovima dok pokušava da izvrši misiju.

programme.title: Profesor Babic I Fortnite Ballistic
programme.desc: Introducing the popular shooter published 2024. years. In order to win, players divided into two teams must show talent, knowledge, but also tactical abilities. / Predstavljamo vam popularnu pucačinu koja je objavljena 2024. godine. Kako bi pobedili, igrači podeljeni u dva tima moraju da pokažu talenat, znanje, ali i taktičke sposobnosti.

programme.title: Blast Open London: 1/2 Finale - Furia Vs G2
programme.desc: In London, the competition in which forces will measure the best Franchise teams Counter-Strike. Follow them while fighting for a better position on the table, but also valuable cash prizes. / U Londonu se održava takmičenje na kom će snage odmeriti najbolji timovi franšize Counter-Strike. programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Power Vs Tugarev / Borilački sport - MMA: Power vs Tugarev
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: BOKS: Sam Eggington - Joe Pigford / Boks: Sam Eggington - Joe Pigford
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Partizan Mozzart Bet - FMP Soccerbet, G1 / Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart bet - FMP Soccerbet, G1
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Radnik - Sloga / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Sloga
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Mega Superbet - Future / Košarka - ABA liga: Mega Superbet - Buducnost
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Jezdeci na dolge steze
programme.desc: After the end of the Civil War, Missouri, Frank and Jesse James joins a group consisting of Coleman brothers, Jim and Bob Younger and Miller's boyfriend. Together, they set up a gang that attacks carriages and banks. The bank's robbery ends with a shooting show with government men. Some of the gang members also have better halves: Coleman Younger spends time with the unyielding Belle Start, while Ed Miller is engaged to Beth restrained. The story begins with a big and successful bank robbery in Missuri and rounds off with a bank robbery in Northfield, which featured a massacre of gang Jessie James. Between the two groundbreaking events, the film shows how men encounter their dear and report how to fight within the gang, how to drink in city taverns and have fun with purchasing women in the curb, how they think to calm down, withdraw and start living a normal life. All the time, the Pinkerton's corrupt agency, which kills their innocent relatives because of the intimidation, is on the trail, which is why public opinion is increasingly on the side of the outcast. The break and massacre occurs with the attack of Jessie James in Northfield. / V Missouriju se po koncu državljanske vojne izobčenca Frank in Jesse James pridružita skupini, ki jo sestavljajo bratje Coleman, Jim in Bob Younger ter Millerjeva fanta. Skupaj ustanovijo tolpo, ki napada kočije in banke. Rop banke se konča s strelskim obračunom z vladnimi možmi. Nekateri od članov tolpe imajo tudi boljše polovice: Coleman Younger preživlja čas z nepopustljivo Belle Start, medtem ko je Ed Miller zaročen z zadržano Beth.Zgodba se prične z velikim in uspešnim bančnim ropom v Missuriju in zaokroži z bančnim ropom v Northfieldu, v katerem je prišlo do masakra tolpe Jessie Jamesa. Med obema prelomnima dogodkoma film prikazuje, kako moški srečujejo svoje drage in se z njimi poročajo, kako prihaja do spopadov znotraj bande, kako popivajo po mestnih krčmah in se zabavajo s kupljivimi ženskami v kurbiščih, kako razmišljajo, da bi se umirili, umaknili in pričelo živeti normalno življenje. Ves čas pa jim je na sledi Pinkertonova skorumpirana agencija, ki zaradi ustrahovanja pobija njihove nedolžne sorodnike, prav zaradi tega pa je javno mnenje vse bolj na strani izobčencev. Do preloma in masakra pa pride ob napadu tolpe Jessie Jamesa v Northfieldu.

programme.desc: There are treasures in the towns and along the fast roads of the United States who just wait for anyone to discover them - valuable historical antiques, hidden in the piles of charms, buried in barns and folded in garages. programme.desc: Women's Bundesliga is starting a new season in which fans can rejoice in top football and close duels. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. programme.title: Sports of young people / Športne igre mladih
programme.desc: Young sports games are an event that gathers young people from all over Europe. They have been organized since 1996, when they first took place in Split, today they take place in Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia and Croatia and are the largest amateur sporting event in this part of Europe. Elementary and high school students compete in ten sports disciplines, and the best advance to the international finals. / Športne igre mladih so dogodek, ki zbere mlade iz vse Evrope. Organizirajo se od leta 1996, ko so se prvič odvile v Splitu, danes se odvijajo v Sloveniji, Bosni in Hercegovini, Srbiji in na Hrvaškem in so največji amaterski športni dogodek v tem delu Evrope. Osnovnošolci in srednješolci se pomerijo v desetih športnih disciplinah, najboljši pa napredujejo v mednarodni finale.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.sub-title: Dictators Nightmare; The Freemasonry Brotherhood was officially established in the early 18th century in London, and according to some, it existed much earlier. Delovanje te organizacije je že od nekdaj zavito v tančico skrivnosti. Dokumentarna seri
programme.desc: Part 1: When Benito Mussolini came to power in Italy in 1922, it was initially supported by Italian Freemasons. Later, however, Mussolini, to gain the support of the Catholic Church, the historical hostess of Freemasons, was banned by fraternity. Her members were persecuted and closed during fascism, much like Spanish Freemasons during Frankism. General Francisco Franco hated Freemasons, nothing less than communists, homosexuals and Jews, and in every public appearance he warned of the danger of Freemasonry conspiracies. When Spain's international community was secluded after World War II, Franco also attributed it to the fact that there are numerous Freemasons among the leaders of the countries. The ban on Freemasonry in Spain was eliminated only after the dictator's death in 1979.dictators Nightmare / Italy / 2022 / Director: Luigi Maria Perotti. / 1. del:Ko je v Italiji leta 1922 prišel na oblast Benito Mussolini, so ga italijanski prostozidarji sprva podpirali. Pozneje pa je Mussolini, da bi si pridobil podporo Katoliške cerkve, zgodovinske sovražnice prostozidarjev, bratovščino prepovedal. Njene člane so med fašizmom preganjali in zapirali, podobno kot španske prostozidarje v času frankizma. General Francisco Franco je namreč prostozidarje sovražil, nič manj kot komuniste, homoseksualce in Jude, zato je v vsakem javnem nastopu opozarjal na nevarnost prostozidarskih zarot. Ko je mednarodna skupnost Španijo po drugi svetovni vojni osamila, je Franco tudi to pripisal dejstvu, da so med voditelji držav zmagovalk številni prostozidarji. Prepoved prostozidarstva so v Španiji odpravili šele po diktatorjevi smrti leta 1979.DICTATORS NIGHTMARE / Italija / 2022 / Režija: Luigi Maria Perotti.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Kolk is an hour - Big Band RTV Slovenia, Lojze Krajnčan and Guests, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Kolk je pa ura – Big band RTV Slovenija, Lojze Krajnčan in gosti, pon.
programme.desc: R: Šmuc Alexander ... Studio TV concert marking the 60th anniversary of Lojze Krajnčan. Composer, conductor and thrombonist Lojze Krajnčan (born 1961) began his journey in the Big Band RTV Slovenia as a thrombinist, continued as a conductor and organizer, and later worked on the work of the artistic director of the Big Band RTV Slovenia. During his years of operation in this orchestra, he has participated in numerous films, in television and radio shows and performed with many top musicians, domestic and foreign. He invited the musicians with whom he successfully collaborated in recent years, with him: Teo Collori (guitar), Žigan Krajnčan (vocals), Kristijan Krajnčan (drums), Marko Črnčec (piano), Uroš Perić (vocals, piano), Renato Chicco (trumpet) and Ana Bezjak (vocals). Director Alexander Šmuc, editor Meta Česnik, editor of the show Daniel Celarec. / R: Šmuc Aleksander... Studijski televizijski koncert ob 60-letnici Lojzeta Krajnčana. Skladatelj, dirigent in trombonist Lojze Krajnčan (roj. 1961) je svojo pot v Big bandu RTV Slovenija začel kot trombonist, nadaljeval kot dirigent in prireditelj, pozneje pa je opravljal tudi delo umetniškega vodje Big banda RTV Slovenija. V letih delovanja v tem orkestru je sodeloval na številnih snemanjih, v televizijskih in radijskih oddajah in nastopal z mnogimi vrhunskimi glasbeniki, domačimi in tujimi. Za svoj Slavnostni koncert je povabil k sodelovanju glasbenike, s katerimi je uspešno sodeloval v zadnjih letih, z njim bodo nastopili: Teo Collori (kitara), Žigan Krajnčan (vokal, ples), Kristijan Krajnčan (bobni), Marko Črnčec (klavir), Uroš Perić (vokal, klavir), Renato Chicco (orgle Hammond), Alex Sipiagin (trobenta) in Ana Bezjak (vokal). Režija Aleksander Šmuc, redaktorica Meta Česnik, urednik oddaje Daniel Celarec.

programme.title: Memories: prof. dr. Niko Tosh, 2. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 2. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.desc: R: Vojko Vidmar ... The Ponikve Folklore Group, coming from Dobrepolje, will present a waltz, polka and tango on stage. This, as is less well known, was part of the dance culture in Slovenia, since it is found here at the beginning of the last century. Tango is already stereotypically perceived as a dance of passion, so in the choreography of Tomaž Simetinger, a passionate competing for the love of a girl who grows into a clash of two dancers for the same dancer. / R: Vojko Vidmar... Ta je bil, kot je morda manj znano, del plesne kulture na Slovenskem, saj ga pri nas zasledimo že v začetku prejšnjega stoletja. programme.sub-title: The Wonders of Europe / Leurope des Mervilles II; The second season of the documentary series of Wonder Europe reveals the history of four unique European landmarks: the Eiffel Tower, the Flores Cathedral, the Roman Pantheon and the magnificent Schonbrunn mansion on / The Wonders Of Europe / Leurope Des Merveilles Ii.; Druga sezona dokumentarne serije Čudesa Evrope razkriva zgodovino štirih edinstvenih evropskih znamenitosti: Eifflovega stolpa, firenške stolnice, rimskega Panteona in veličastnega dvorca Schonbrunn na
programme.desc: Part 2: Roman Pantheon, Oda to the Empire, reveals the stunning history of one of the most famous shrines of all time, the Roman Pantheon, "Temple of all the gods." It was built by Consul Mark Agrip, around the year 25 BC, at the time of the reign of his good friend, the first Roman emperor Augustus. After two devastating fires, 150 years later, he was rebuilt and upgraded by Emperor Hadrian, a passionate lover of architecture. His creation, the famous giant's concrete dome, with which he covered the pantheon, still admires the whole world today. The Wonders of Europe II. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte. / 2. del: Rimski Panteon, oda cesarstvuDrugi del razkriva osupljivo zgodovino enega najznamenitejših svetišč vseh časov, rimskega Panteona, »templja vseh bogov«. Zgraditi ga je dal konzul Mark Agripa, in sicer okrog leta 25 pred našim štetjem, v času vladanja njegovega dobrega prijatelja, prvega rimskega cesarja Avgusta. Po dveh uničujočih požarih ga je 150 let pozneje obnovil in nadgradil cesar Hadrijan, strasten ljubitelj arhitekture. Njegovo stvaritev, slovito orjaško betonsko kupolo, s katero je pokril Panteon, še danes občuduje ves svet. THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte.

programme.title: Hotel Bombai
programme.desc: The Taj Mahal Palace hotel is attacked by a terrorist group. The hotel staff, with the famous chef Hemant Oberi in the lead, decide to risk their lives to keep the rest of hostages safe and try to reverse the difficult situation. With three short Coordinated I leave 173 dead and three hundred injured. For this, it uses a script that co-writes together with John Collee (the last wolf) and an cast headed by Dev Patel (who was nominated for the Oscar for his interpretation in Slumdog Millonaire) to which other faces known as Armie Hammer (Call Me by Your Name) and Nazanin Boniadi (Ben-Hur) accompany. / El Hotel Taj Mahal Palace es atacado por un grupo terrorista. El personal del hotel, con el famoso chef Hemant Oberoi en cabeza, deciden arriesgar sus vidas para mantener al resto de rehenes a salvo e intentar revertir la difícil situacion.Con tres cortos a sus espaldas, Anthony Maras debuta en la realizacion de largometrajes con esta cinta dramática que intenta reconstruir el atentado terrorista acaecido el 26 de noviembre de 2008 en la India, cuando una serie de 12 ataques coordinados dejo como saldo 173 muertos y tres centenares de heridos. Para ello se sirve de un guion que coescribe junto a John Collee (El último lobo) y de un elenco encabezado por Dev Patel (quien estuvo nominado al Oscar por su interpretacion en Slumdog Millonaire) al que acompañanan otros rostros conocidos como Armie Hammer (Call me by your name) y Nazanin Boniadi (Ben-Hur).

programme.title: Assassins Creed
programme.desc: The Order of the Knights Templars takes centuries looking for the mythical fruit of the Eden - in which the key to free will - is located to be able to control freedom and human thought. In Andalusia, in 1492, the brotherhood of the Assassins commission Aguilar de Nerja to disrupt the Templar plans. Michael Fassbender stars "Assassins Creed", adaptation to the big screen of the Ubisoft video game series of the same title. / La orden de los caballeros templarios lleva siglos buscando el mítico Fruto del Eden -en el que se encuentra la clave del libre albedrío- para poder controlar la libertad y el pensamiento humano. En Andalucía, en 1492, la hermandad de los assassins encarga a Aguilar de Nerja que desbarate los planes templarios. Michael Fassbender protagoniza "Assassins Creed", adaptacion a la gran pantalla de la serie de videojuegos de Ubisoft del mismo título.
